source: sdk-conformance/corpus/imposters — the Mountebank-drivable fixtures, loaded from the corpus itself so a corpus change is diffed too

dropStubs.name: xpath — XML body where //user/@role == 'admin'
dropStubs.reason: Mountebank 2.9.5 creates the imposter but fails every request this stub is tried on with a 500 TypeError (`result.map is not a function`): its xpath predicate handles node sets only, and `string(//user/@role)` is a string. Rift's support is documented in differences.md (#1495)

dropStubs.name: wait — random delay between 200ms and 1200ms
dropStubs.reason: a `wait` written as a `{"min", "max"}` range is a Rift extension Mountebank refuses (docs/mountebank/behaviors.md)

dropStubs.reason: a `_rift.script` rhai response; Mountebank has no rhai engine
